ne16ac66244.headline: Dubai's hottest real estate spots in 2025: Where did billions flow?
ne16ac66244.summary: Dubai's real estate market set a fifth consecutive annual record in 2025, generating an unprecedented AED 682bn in sales. The report asks where the billions flowed across the city.
ne16ac66244.why: Dubai property is a major driver of the UAE economy and attracts foreign capital, so sales volumes signal demand from investors and wealthy buyers.

ne29385644d.headline: US Bond Yields Climb on Economic Optimism
ne29385644d.summary: US bond yields climbed in early 2026 as economic optimism reduced safe-haven demand and lifted investor confidence.
ne29385644d.why: Treasury yields set the benchmark cost of borrowing across the economy and move the valuation of most fixed-income and equity assets.
ne29385644d.why_moved: Economic optimism reduced safe-haven demand for Treasuries, pushing yields higher as investors shifted toward riskier assets.

n1bbe6cfe01.headline: Kenya: CBK Licenses 42 More Digital Credit Providers, Total Now 195
n1bbe6cfe01.summary: The Central Bank of Kenya licensed an additional 42 Digital Credit Providers, bringing the total of regulated digital lenders in the country to 195.
n1bbe6cfe01.why: Licensing brings digital lenders under central bank supervision, affecting consumer credit markets and the competitive landscape for mobile lending firms.

n6cc290d89e.headline: Iran: Trump warns US will intervene if Iran kills protesters
n6cc290d89e.summary: US President Donald Trump said 'we will come to their rescue' if Iran kills protesters, after days of demonstrations and clashes.
n6cc290d89e.why: Iran is a major oil producer, and instability or US military involvement there can affect crude supply expectations and regional risk premiums.

n262917f4eb.headline: Trump delays increased tariffs on upholstered furniture, kitchen cabinets and vanities for a year
n262917f4eb.summary: President Trump signed a New Year's Eve proclamation delaying increased tariffs on upholstered furniture, kitchen cabinets and vanities for one year, citing ongoing trade talks.
n262917f4eb.why: Tariffs on imported furniture and cabinetry raise costs for US importers, retailers and home builders, and their timing shapes sourcing decisions.

ne0db4aec17.headline: Brazil steel outlook hinges on anti-dumping measures: INDA
ne0db4aec17.summary: The Brazilian steel outlook hinges on anti-dumping measures, according to INDA, which says these measures will shape market stability and growth in the coming year.
ne0db4aec17.why: Anti-dumping duties protect domestic producers from low-priced imports, influencing steel prices, margins and demand for industrial users in Brazil.

n12e005b8ba.summary: The CAC 40 rose 0.4% to around 8,180 points less than two hours into the 2026 opening session. STMicroelectronics and Stellantis were among the gainers.
n12e005b8ba.why: The CAC 40 is the benchmark index of the largest listed companies in France. STMicroelectronics is a major European chipmaker and Stellantis a leading carmaker.

nb557a45ac2.headline: Iran Accepts Cryptocurrency as Payment for Advanced Weapons
nb557a45ac2.summary: Iran has accepted cryptocurrency as payment for advanced weapons, a move described as a significant escalation in efforts to bypass Western sanctions through blockchain technology.
nb557a45ac2.why: Sanctions evasion through crypto draws scrutiny from regulators and exchanges. Such activity can affect compliance costs and the regulatory climate for digital assets.

n29045ac4a9.why: Iran is a major oil producer, and tensions in the Middle East can affect crude prices and regional risk premiums.

n29f660e480.headline: Weekend glory for Indian stock market as Nifty hits new record high, Sensex closes 573 points higher
n29f660e480.summary: The Nifty hit a new record high and the Sensex closed 573 points higher on Friday. At their highs, the Sensex had gained more than 623 points and the Nifty 193 points.
n29f660e480.why: The Nifty 50 and BSE Sensex are India's main benchmark indices, tracking large listed companies across sectors.
n29f660e480.why_moved: The article reports the Nifty reaching a record high and the Sensex closing higher on Friday, with both gaining intraday.

n92796b5f28.headline: Brisbane beats Sydney and Melbourne in price growth
n92796b5f28.summary: Brisbane's housing market is among the strongest nationally, with prices up 1.6% in December. Sydney and Melbourne saw some moderation in property valuation growth.
n92796b5f28.why: Residential property prices influence household wealth, mortgage risk and the Reserve Bank of Australia's view of the economy.

n1a194b1ed2.headline: Maduro Says He Welcomes U.S. Investments in Venezuela’s Oil
n1a194b1ed2.summary: Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro softened his rhetoric by inviting US investment in the country's oil sector. The comments were described as a possible path to serious talks with Washington.
n1a194b1ed2.why: Venezuela's state oil company PDVSA controls the country's large crude reserves, and foreign investment would determine how fast output can recover.

nc47df0648f.headline: India equities expected to be resilient in 2026; autos, banks to outperform
nc47df0648f.summary: A new report said India's equity markets should remain resilient in 2026 despite global uncertainty, supported by domestic fundamentals and policy support. Autos and banks are expected to outperform.
nc47df0648f.why: India's equity market is one of the largest emerging markets, and sector leadership among autos and banks reflects domestic consumption and credit growth.

n2656a9a479.headline: Full list of high street stores closing in 2026 from Primark to River Island
n2656a9a479.summary: A list of high street brands set to close stores in 2026 includes Primark, Poundland, River Island and Tresspass. The closures add to pressure on UK store-based retail.
n2656a9a479.why: High street retailers are a key part of UK consumer spending, and store closures reflect shifts in demand, costs and online competition.

ne46ffd0c98.headline: At least six killed during protests over Iran's economy
ne46ffd0c98.summary: At least six people have been killed in widening protests against Iran's worsening economy, according to reports.
ne46ffd0c98.why: Economic unrest and sanctions pressure affect Iran's currency, inflation and its oil export outlook.

nc38cb0b10c.summary: Aluminium hit US$3,000 for the first time since 2022. Chinese smelting caps and European production limits are trimming global inventories amid strong construction and renewable demand.
nc38cb0b10c.why: Aluminium is a key industrial metal used in construction, packaging, and renewable energy equipment, and its price is set on the London Metal Exchange.

n0445af6110.headline: Precious metals start 2026 strong on rate-cut optimism, global risks
n0445af6110.summary: Precious metals rebounded from year-end declines on Friday as tensions between major powers and hopes for US rate cuts boosted investor appetite.
n0445af6110.why: Gold and silver are widely held as stores of value and tend to respond to real interest rates, the US dollar and geopolitical risk.
n0445af6110.why_moved: Rate-cut expectations and tensions between major powers increased investor demand for precious metals.

n728992014c.headline: Televerbier Increases Annual Revenue by 21%
n728992014c.summary: Televerbier reported revenue of CHF 85.6 million for its 2024-25 fiscal year, a 21% year-on-year rise, with CHF 10.1 million generated in the second half.
n728992014c.why: Televerbier operates ski lifts in the Swiss resort of Verbier, and its results reflect winter tourism demand in the Alps.

n50383f5fc0.headline: Date for contactless change plan for Sainsbury’s, Tesco, Aldi, Asda
n50383f5fc0.summary: Banks and card providers will be given the power to set unlimited amounts for contactless payments at tills, under a planned change affecting major UK supermarkets. Retailers include Sainsbury's, Tesco, Aldi and Asda.
n50383f5fc0.why: Contactless payment limits govern how card payments are processed at UK retailers, affecting card issuers, payment networks and retailers. Rule changes shape payment volumes and fraud exposure.

n4c05d661f0.headline: Renault Stands Out in a Contracting French Auto Market
n4c05d661f0.summary: Renault strengthened its position in a shrinking French automotive market in 2025. The company credited a refreshed lineup, a sharp commercial strategy and a push toward electrification.
n4c05d661f0.why: Renault is a major French carmaker, and its performance indicates the health of Europe's auto industry and the EV transition.

n270297e142.headline: OPEC+ Set to Keep Oil Production Policy Despite Saudi-UAE Spat
n270297e142.summary: The OPEC+ alliance is expected to confirm it will hold oil production steady through the first quarter of 2026. The decision comes despite a public spat between Saudi Arabia and the UAE over Yemen.
n270297e142.why: OPEC+ is a group of major oil producers that coordinates output, and its production decisions directly influence global crude prices.
n270297e142.why_moved: The alliance is expected to keep output steady through Q1 2026 despite a public rift between Saudi Arabia and the UAE over their opposing roles in Yemen. Markets may read the policy continuity as limiting near-term supply changes.

nf115b3d94b.why: The FTSE 100 tracks the largest companies listed in London, many with global revenues. Milestones like this reflect broad UK equity sentiment.

nc5bbe5a789.summary: The past year saw completion of one of Boston's largest real estate projects, while new development approvals continued to slow.
nc5bbe5a789.why: Development approvals are a leading indicator of future construction activity, affecting developers, lenders and the local housing supply.

n2ad4cbd711.headline: Govt busts fake claim on RBI withdrawing Rs 500 notes from ATMs by March 2026
n2ad4cbd711.summary: The Central government rebutted fake information on social media claiming the Reserve Bank of India would stop Rs 500 notes from ATMs by March 2026. The claim was described as false.
n2ad4cbd711.why: The Reserve Bank of India issues the country's currency, and official clarifications help prevent confusion over cash availability.

n83d86d8e1e.summary: President Donald Trump has delayed the implementation of higher tariffs on certain household products, citing ongoing trade discussions.

n992c134137.summary: India's manufacturing expansion slowed to its weakest pace in two years in December as demand softened and firms curbed production. The slowdown is also hitting the labour market.

nc2170ff321.summary: Mandaue City government has started implementing a business tax increase in 2026 under a city ordinance. The adjustment is being staggered over the year.

ne83e1f0729.summary: The US dollar fell about 10% in 2025, but analysts see signs of a possible rebound in 2026. Drivers cited include Treasury liquidity and a Supreme Court tariff ruling.
ne83e1f0729.why: The US Dollar Index (DXY) tracks the dollar against a basket of major currencies and influences global commodity prices and capital flows.
